terra.problem: Calling Samson Israel's judge draws on a fact outside this passage, but gives no reference.
Calling Samson Israel's judge draws on a fact outside this passage, but gives no reference.
The passage does not say Samson wasn't hiding from anybody.
The text places Delilah in the Valley of Sorek but does not say she lived there.
The text does not say Delilah walked away, and she learned that the bowstrings did not subdue Samson, so 'knowing nothing new' overstates the text.
The passage says Samson snapped the ropes; it does not say whether he subsequently ran anywhere.
'No more ropes or straps' implies straps had been part of the earlier attempts, but the text mentions bowstrings and ropes, not straps.
The text says Samson woke and pulled out the pin with the loom and web; it does not say he got up.
The text says Samson woke and pulled out the pin with the loom and web; it does not say he got up.
The passage does not say Samson never worried about courage.
The text says Delilah called out to Samson that the Philistines were there, not that she called out to the Philistines right away.
The text says the lords brought money, but does not establish that they brought no gifts for Samson.
